1. Concentrate and focus while revising (Passage 1)
	* Use tools such as recording your revision on your phone to help retain the information (Passage 1)
	* Make revision cards and highlight important information (Passage 3)
2. Practice past paper questions (Passage 2 & Passage 3)
	* Doing past paper questions can help you understand how to apply the information you've revised (Passage 2)
	* See how to answer exam questions to gain maximum marks (Passage 3)
3. Teach someone else what you're revising (Passage 3)
	* Revising and teaching someone else can help solidify your understanding of the material (Passage 3)
4. Take breaks and relax during revision (Passage 5)
	* Don't rush through your revision and take breaks to relax and avoid burnout (Passage 5)
